ptr.note: Borrowed output slot (must not be NULL): written NULL first, then, on success only, given a fresh av_mallocz context that owns its algorithm child (av_md5/murmur3/ripemd/sha/sha512_alloc; CRC32 borrows the static table, adler32 has none). Constructor of AVHashContext: av_hash_freep releases context and child. On failure (unknown name EINVAL, ENOMEM) partial storage is freed and the slot stays NULL. Hashing state requires av_hash_init.
Case-insensitive name read only during call; never retained.
